import R54EventEThirdDipBoundarySaturation
import R54EventEFourthEdgeTrichotomy

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 800000

namespace ChompLean

/-!
R55: two genuine reductions of the remaining propagated Event-E atoms.

First, a fourth-edge packet hit after the no-third-dip branch is not an
anonymous later dip.  UnitDip and the fact that the hit value is below `z`
force the exact delayed descent

    d(s+3) = z,   d(s+4) = z-1.

The diagonal lower bound then buys one additional unit of defect slack.
In particular this whole hit branch is absent on the first still-open face
`s-delta-4=2`.

Second, the four-prefix propagation cannot continue as an unbounded menu.
Every individual four-prefix value either is (or becomes) a completed row
start, hence is permanent, or has a first loss edge no later than the row
whose index is the value itself.  Since every such value is below `z`, this
is a finite induction horizon internal to the existing certificate.

Finally, the third-dip band hit gets an exact source-slot order constraint:
if both named high packet columns lie to the left of its `z-1` host, two
extra source values improve the host lower bound by one.
-/

private theorem r55_nodup_lower_with_two_high
    {m x y : Nat}
    (hmx : m <= x) (hmy : m <= y) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ((List.range' 1 (m - 1)) ++ [x, y]).Nodup := by
  apply List.nodup_append.mpr
  refine ⟨List.nodup_range' 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [hxy]
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    have haRange := List.mem_range'_1.mp ha
    simp at hb
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> omega

/-- A high MEX cell which has two distinct source values at or above its
output needs two slots in addition to the complete lower interval. -/
theorem high_cell_two_high_sources_capacity
    (M : RecurrenceModel) {q r m x y : Nat}
    (hrq : r <= q) (hqm : q < m) (hout : M.f q r = m)
    (hx : B M.f q r x) (hy : B M.f q r y)
    (hmx : m <= x) (hmy : m <= y) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (m - 1) + 2 <= q + r := by
  let xs := (List.range' 1 (m - 1)) ++ [x, y]
  have hnd : xs.Nodup := by
    dsimp [xs]
    exact r55_nodup_lower_with_two_high hmx hmy hxy
  have hsub : xs ⊆ BValueList M.f q r := by
    intro v hv
    apply mem_BValueList_iff.mpr
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hv with hvLower | hvHigh
    · have hvRange := List.mem_range'_1.mp hvLower
      exact M.mex_no_skip hrq (by rw [hout]; exact hqm) (by omega) (by
        rw [hout]
        omega)
    · simp at hvHigh
      rcases hvHigh with rfl | rfl
      · exact hx
      · exact hy
  have hcap := nodup_subset_length_le hnd hsub
  rw [length_BValueList] at hcap
  simp only [xs, List.length_append, List.length_range',
    List.length_cons] at hcap
  omega

/-- The exact extra-slot order forced on the third-dip packet hit. -/
theorem eventE_third_dip_band_hit_source_order
    {s delta z c b0 : Nat}
    (hcross : EventECrossEdgeSurvivorCertificate s delta z c b0)
    (hhit : EventEThirdDipBandHitCompressedCertificate
      s delta z c b0)
    (hsum : (z + 1) + delta = 2 * s) :
    exists g,
      g ∈ EventEThirdMissingBandSlots s delta c b0 /\
      gameF s g = z - 1 /\
      (g < c \/ g < b0 \/ s - delta - 1 <= g) := by
  rcases hhit with
    ⟨_hpen, hstair, _hlast, _hweighted, _hfour,
      g, _b1, _b2, hgMissing, _hb1, _hb2,
      hgValue, _hhost1, _hhost2, _hgb1, _hb1b2, _hgb2⟩
  refine ⟨g, hgMissing, hgValue, ?_⟩
  by_cases hgc : g < c
  · exact Or.inl hgc
  by_cases hgb : g < b0
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hgb)
  right
  right
  have hgTriple : g ∈ EventETriplePrefixBandSlots s delta c b0 :=
    (List.mem_filter.mp hgMissing).1
  have hgSurv : g ∈ EventESurvivingBandSlots s delta c b0 :=
    (List.mem_filter.mp hgTriple).1
  have hgSlots : g ∈ EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0 :=
    (List.mem_filter.mp hgSurv).1
  have hbase := hcross.1.1.1
  rcases hbase with
    ⟨hc, hb0, hcNe, hSucc, hBase,
      _hslotsNodup, _hslotsLen, hslotsProps, _hweak⟩
  have hgData := hslotsProps g hgSlots
  have hgLt : g < s := hgData.1
  have hcg : c < g := by omega
  have hb0g : b0 < g := by omega
  have hpHigh : s < z - 1 := by
    have hdiag3 := hstair.2.2.2.2.1
    have hgt := gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt (s + 3)
    change s + 3 < gameF (s + 3) (s + 3) at hgt
    omega
  have hCsucc : C gameF s g (z + 1) :=
    ⟨c, hcg, hSucc⟩
  have hCbase : C gameF s g z :=
    ⟨b0, hb0g, hBase⟩
  have hcap := high_cell_two_high_sources_capacity
    gameRecurrenceModel (q := s) (r := g) (m := z - 1)
      (x := z) (y := z + 1)
      (Nat.le_of_lt hgLt) hpHigh hgValue
      (Or.inr hCbase) (Or.inr hCsucc)
      (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

/-- Exact normal form of a fourth-edge hit following the no-third-dip
branch.  Besides the delayed diagonal identities it records four literal
prehosts of `z-1` and the stronger defect gap `delta+7 <= s`. -/
def EventEFourthDipExactDelayedHitCertificate
    (s delta z c b0 : Nat) : Prop :=
  EventEFourthDipPacketHitCertificate s delta z c b0 /\
  gameF (s + 3) (s + 3) = z /\
  gameF (s + 4) (s + 4) = z - 1 /\
  delta + 7 <= s /\
  exists g b1 b2 b3,
    g ∈ EventEFourthMissingBandSlots s delta c b0 /\
    b1 < s + 1 /\ b2 < s + 2 /\ b3 < s + 3 /\
    gameF s g = z - 1 /\
    gameF (s + 1) b1 = z - 1 /\
    gameF (s + 2) b2 = z - 1 /\
    gameF (s + 3) b3 = z - 1 /\
    g ≠ b1 /\ g ≠ b2 /\ g ≠ b3 /\
    b1 ≠ b2 /\ b1 ≠ b3 /\ b2 ≠ b3

theorem gameF_nonmax_eventE_fourth_dip_hit_exact_delayed
    (hU : UnitDip gameRecurrenceModel) {s c b0 : Nat}
    (hres : NonmaxMarginEventECrossEdgeResidual s)
    (hcross : EventECrossEdgeSurvivorCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0)
    (hcert : EventENonDipSharedOwnerSaturationCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0)
    (hhit : EventEFourthDipPacketHitCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0) :
    EventEFourthDipExactDelayedHitCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0 := by
  classical
  let d := gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)
  let delta := 2 * s - d
  let z := d - 1
  change NonmaxMarginEventECrossEdgeResidual s at hres
  change EventECrossEdgeSurvivorCertificate s delta z c b0 at hcross
  change EventENonDipSharedOwnerSaturationCertificate
    s delta z c b0 at hcert
  change EventEFourthDipPacketHitCertificate s delta z c b0 at hhit
  have hresData := hres
  change MarginEventECounterexample s /\
      EventEDefectPacketInvariant s d delta z /\
      delta + 5 <= s /\
      exists ce be, EventECrossEdgeSurvivorCertificate s delta z ce be
    at hresData
  rcases hresData with ⟨hEvent, hInv, _hnonmax, _hexists⟩
  rcases hEvent with ⟨_hdip0, _hmargin, hdip1⟩
  have hsum : d + delta = 2 * s := hInv.2.2.1
  have hzDiag : z + 1 = d := hInv.2.2.2.1
  have hunit1 := hU (s + 1) hdip1
  change gameF (s + 2) (s + 2) + 1 = d at hunit1
  have hdiag2 : gameF (s + 2) (s + 2) = z := by omega
  have hnondip : Not
      (gameF (s + 3) (s + 3) < gameF (s + 2) (s + 2)) :=
    hcert.1.1
  have hdip3 := hhit.1
  have hunit3 := hU (s + 3) hdip3
  change gameF (s + 4) (s + 4) + 1 =
    gameF (s + 3) (s + 3) at hunit3
  rcases hhit.2.2.2 with ⟨g, hgMissing, hgValue⟩
  have hgFour : g ∈ EventEFourPrefixBandSlots s delta c b0 :=
    (List.mem_filter.mp hgMissing).1
  have hgTriple : g ∈ EventETriplePrefixBandSlots s delta c b0 :=
    (List.mem_filter.mp hgFour).1
  have hgSurv : g ∈ EventESurvivingBandSlots s delta c b0 :=
    (List.mem_filter.mp hgTriple).1
  have hgSlots : g ∈ EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0 :=
    (List.mem_filter.mp hgSurv).1
  have hbase := hcross.1.1.1
  rcases hbase with
    ⟨_hc, _hb0, _hcNe, _hSucc, _hBase,
      _hslotsNodup, _hslotsLen, hslotsProps, _hweak⟩
  have hbelow : gameF s g < z := by
    have htransition := (hslotsProps g hgSlots).2.2.2
    simpa [EventELowerTransition] using htransition.2.1
  have hdiag4Below : gameF (s + 4) (s + 4) < z := by
    rw [← hgValue]
    exact hbelow
  have hdiag3 : gameF (s + 3) (s + 3) = z := by omega
  have hdiag4 : gameF (s + 4) (s + 4) = z - 1 := by omega
  have hgt4 := gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt (s + 4)
  change s + 4 < gameF (s + 4) (s + 4) at hgt4
  have hgap : delta + 7 <= s := by omega

  have hrow1 : gameF s g ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 1) := by
    have hf := (List.mem_filter.mp hgSurv).2
    simpa [EventESurvivingBandSlots] using hf
  have hrow2 : gameF s g ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 2) := by
    have hf := (List.mem_filter.mp hgTriple).2
    simpa [EventETriplePrefixBandSlots] using hf
  have hrow3 : gameF s g ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 3) := by
    have hf := (List.mem_filter.mp hgFour).2
    simpa [EventEFourPrefixBandSlots] using hf
  rcases mem_strictRowPrefixValues_iff_C.mp hrow1 with ⟨b1, hb1, hhost1⟩
  rcases mem_strictRowPrefixValues_iff_C.mp hrow2 with ⟨b2, hb2, hhost2⟩
  rcases mem_strictRowPrefixValues_iff_C.mp hrow3 with ⟨b3, hb3, hhost3⟩
  have hpHigh : s + 4 < z - 1 := by omega
  have hgb1 : g ≠ b1 := by
    intro heq
    subst b1
    exact encoding_same_lower_no_repeat game_encodes
      (s := g) (t₁ := s) (t₂ := s + 1) (p := z - 1)
      (hslotsProps g hgSlots).1 (by omega) (by omega)
      (hgValue.trans hdiag4) ((hhost1.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
  have hgb2 : g ≠ b2 := by
    intro heq
    subst b2
    exact encoding_same_lower_no_repeat game_encodes
      (s := g) (t₁ := s) (t₂ := s + 2) (p := z - 1)
      (hslotsProps g hgSlots).1 (by omega) (by omega)
      (hgValue.trans hdiag4) ((hhost2.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
  have hgb3 : g ≠ b3 := by
    intro heq
    subst b3
    exact encoding_same_lower_no_repeat game_encodes
      (s := g) (t₁ := s) (t₂ := s + 3) (p := z - 1)
      (hslotsProps g hgSlots).1 (by omega) (by omega)
      (hgValue.trans hdiag4) ((hhost3.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
  have hb12 : b1 ≠ b2 := by
    intro heq
    subst b2
    exact encoding_same_lower_no_repeat game_encodes
      (s := b1) (t₁ := s + 1) (t₂ := s + 2) (p := z - 1)
      hb1 (by omega) (by omega)
      ((hhost1.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
      ((hhost2.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
  have hb13 : b1 ≠ b3 := by
    intro heq
    subst b3
    exact encoding_same_lower_no_repeat game_encodes
      (s := b1) (t₁ := s + 1) (t₂ := s + 3) (p := z - 1)
      hb1 (by omega) (by omega)
      ((hhost1.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
      ((hhost3.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
  have hb23 : b2 ≠ b3 := by
    intro heq
    subst b3
    exact encoding_same_lower_no_repeat game_encodes
      (s := b2) (t₁ := s + 2) (t₂ := s + 3) (p := z - 1)
      hb2 (by omega) (by omega)
      ((hhost2.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
      ((hhost3.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4)
  change EventEFourthDipExactDelayedHitCertificate s delta z c b0
  exact ⟨hhit, hdiag3, hdiag4, hgap,
    g, b1, b2, b3, hgMissing, hb1, hb2, hb3,
    hgValue.trans hdiag4, (hhost1.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4,
    (hhost2.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4,
    (hhost3.trans hgValue).trans hdiag4,
    hgb1, hgb2, hgb3, hb12, hb13, hb23⟩

/-- The fourth-dip hit atom is completely absent on the first remaining
defect face `ell=2`. -/
theorem gameF_no_nonmax_eventE_fourth_dip_hit_at_slack_two
    (hU : UnitDip gameRecurrenceModel) {s c b0 : Nat}
    (hres : NonmaxMarginEventECrossEdgeResidual s)
    (hcross : EventECrossEdgeSurvivorCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0)
    (hcert : EventENonDipSharedOwnerSaturationCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0)
    (hell : s - (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)) - 4 = 2) :
    Not (EventEFourthDipPacketHitCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0) := by
  intro hhit
  have hexact := gameF_nonmax_eventE_fourth_dip_hit_exact_delayed
    hU hres hcross hcert hhit
  have hgap := hexact.2.2.2.1
  have hnonmax := hres.2.2.1
  omega

/-- On `ell=2` the old fourth-edge trichotomy is now a dichotomy: only the
extra-forbidden branch or the no-fourth-dip five-prefix branch remains. -/
theorem gameF_nonmax_eventE_slack_two_fourth_edge_dichotomy
    (hU : UnitDip gameRecurrenceModel) {s c b0 : Nat}
    (hres : NonmaxMarginEventECrossEdgeResidual s)
    (hcross : EventECrossEdgeSurvivorCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0)
    (hcert : EventENonDipSharedOwnerSaturationCertificate
      s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
        (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0)
    (hell : s - (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)) - 4 = 2) :
    EventEFourthDipExtraForbiddenCertificate
        s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
          (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0 \/
    EventENoFourthDipFivePrefixSharedOwnerCertificate
        s (2 * s - gameF (s + 1) (s + 1))
          (gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1) c b0 := by
  have htri := gameF_nonmax_eventE_fourth_edge_trichotomy
    hU hres hcross hcert
  rcases htri with hhit | hextra | hnondip
  · exact False.elim
      (gameF_no_nonmax_eventE_fourth_dip_hit_at_slack_two
        hU hres hcross hcert hell hhit)
  · exact Or.inl hextra
  · exact Or.inr hnondip

private theorem r55_finite_chain_first_loss
    (P : Nat -> Prop) (a n : Nat) (hstart : P a) :
    P (a + n) \/
      exists k, k < n /\ P (a + k) /\ Not (P (a + k + 1)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      left
      simpa using hstart
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases ih with hlast | ⟨k, hk, hPk, hloss⟩
      · by_cases hnext : P (a + n + 1)
        · left
          simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hnext
        · right
          exact ⟨n, by omega, hlast, by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hnext⟩
      · right
        exact ⟨k, by omega, hPk, hloss⟩

/-- Finite fate of one four-prefix value: permanent completed row start, or
an exact first loss edge before `z`. -/
def EventEFourPrefixFiniteFate
    (s z g : Nat) : Prop :=
  (exists p r,
    p = gameF s g /\ r < p /\ gameF p r = p /\
    forall t, p < t -> C gameF t t p) \/
  (exists t,
    s + 4 <= t /\ t <= gameF s g /\ t < z /\
    gameF s g ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (t - 1) /\
    gameF s g ∉ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF t)

/-- Prefix-induction closure for all fourth/fifth/etc. descendants.  There
is no infinite propagation atom hidden behind `Q4`: each value resolves
strictly before row `z`. -/
theorem eventE_four_prefix_value_finite_fate
    {s delta z c b0 g : Nat}
    (hcross : EventECrossEdgeSurvivorCertificate s delta z c b0)
    (hg : g ∈ EventEFourPrefixBandSlots s delta c b0) :
    EventEFourPrefixFiniteFate s z g := by
  classical
  have hnormal := gameF_eventE_four_prefix_value_rowstart_or_high
    hcross hg
  rcases hnormal with hstart | hhigh
  · left
    rcases hstart with ⟨p, r, hp, _hpBound, hr, hrow, hperm⟩
    exact ⟨p, r, hp, hr, hrow, hperm⟩
  · let p := gameF s g
    have hpLower : s + 4 <= p := hhigh.1
    have hpUpper : p < z := hhigh.2
    have hPstart : p ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF (s + 3) := by
      have hf := (List.mem_filter.mp hg).2
      simpa [p, EventEFourPrefixBandSlots] using hf
    have hle : s + 3 <= p := by omega
    have hend : s + 3 + (p - (s + 3)) = p := by omega
    have hchain := r55_finite_chain_first_loss
      (fun t => p ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF t)
      (s + 3) (p - (s + 3)) hPstart
    rcases hchain with hfinal | ⟨k, hk, hpresent, habsent⟩
    · have hpPrefix : p ∈ StrictRowPrefixValues gameF p := by
        simpa only [hend] using hfinal
      rcases mem_strictRowPrefixValues_iff_C.mp hpPrefix with
        ⟨r, hr, hrow⟩
      left
      refine ⟨p, r, rfl, hr, hrow, ?_⟩
      intro t hpt
      apply (rowstart_hosted_iff_below_diagonal
        gameRecurrenceModel hr hrow).2
      have hdiag := gameRecurrenceModel.diagonal_gt t
      omega
    · right
      let t := s + 3 + k + 1
      refine ⟨t, by dsimp [t]; omega, by dsimp [t]; omega,
        by dsimp [t]; omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have htPred : t - 1 = s + 3 + k := by
          omega
        rw [htPred]
        exact hpresent
      · simpa [t, Nat.add_assoc] using habsent

#print axioms high_cell_two_high_sources_capacity
#print axioms eventE_third_dip_band_hit_source_order
#print axioms gameF_nonmax_eventE_fourth_dip_hit_exact_delayed
#print axioms gameF_no_nonmax_eventE_fourth_dip_hit_at_slack_two
#print axioms gameF_nonmax_eventE_slack_two_fourth_edge_dichotomy
#print axioms eventE_four_prefix_value_finite_fate

end ChompLean
